objects.name: SEU_B_OSMWAY_1056927545__V05JY_window_mullions
objects.assumption: Group identity, six levels, recessed/piered facade and panelled shallow roof supported by official completed-project photograph, 2017. All detailed dimensions, panel/window counts, railing rhythm and metric heights estimated. Ground stilt zones not modeled because individual locations unconfirmed. v16: mullion ends extended 60 mm into existing frame bounds to remove glass cap coplanarity; joinery dimension is modeling estimate, not survey. Visible front face and width unchanged; rear embedded 30 mm toward backing frame for contact, not an air gap.
